explanation: The mother swallowed her eggs or young tadpoles and shut down her stomach acid while they grew, then brought up fully formed froglets through her mouth.

claims.text: Australian gastric-brooding frogs (genus Rheobatrachus) raised their young in the mother's stomach and gave birth through her mouth.
The mother gastric-brooding frog stopped producing stomach acid while the young developed.
The young emerged from the mother's mouth as fully formed froglets.
